svg.title: Where the agent works
svg.desc: Three places the agent works: a tab in your Chrome through ca browser on any OS; a private desktop through ca env; and your own desktop only when you ask, through the KWin plugin on KDE Wayland, SkyLight on macOS or UI Automation on Windows.

g.text: Any OS. DOM events in a tab of its own,
never your pointer or your tabs. Your
click in that tab takes it back.
Its own KWin, seat, clipboard and bus
for testing apps. On Windows and
macOS, a Linux box in Docker.
ca click, ca drag, ca type
Next to your pointer: the KWin plugin on
KDE Wayland, SkyLight on macOS, UI
